The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only - your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version

import subprocess, sys, os, json
WORK="/tmp/stdprobe"
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
open(WORK+"/go.mod","w").write("module example.com/sp\n\ngo 1.21\n")

def probe(paths):
    """Return set of paths classified as std."""
    paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
    res=set()
    B=200
    for i in range(0,len(paths),B):
        chunk=paths[i:i+B]
        # marker guaranteed general
        chunk2=chunk+["zzz.marker/general"]
        src="package main\n\nimport (\n"+"".join('\t"%s"\n'%p for p in chunk2)+")\n"
        open(WORK+"/p.go","w").write(src)
        out=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable","-output","stdout",WORK+"/p.go"],
                           capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=WORK)
        if out.returncode!=0:
            print("ERR",out.returncode,out.stderr[-2000:],file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
        # parse groups
        lines=out.stdout.splitlines()
        try:
            s=lines.index("import (")
        except ValueError:
            print("no import block:",out.stdout[:500],file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
        e=lines.index(")",s)
        groups=[[]]
        for ln in lines[s+1:e]:
            if ln.strip()=="":
                groups.append([]); continue
            groups[-1].append(ln.strip().strip('"'))
        # the group containing zzz.marker/general is the general group
        gen_idx=[i for i,g in enumerate(groups) if "zzz.marker/general" in g]
        if not gen_idx:
            print("marker missing",out.stdout,file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
        gi=gen_idx[0]
        for i,g in enumerate(groups):
            if i!=gi: res.update(g)
    return res

if __name__=="__main__":
    cands=[l.strip() for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if l.strip()]
    std=probe(cands)
    for p in sorted(std): print(p)
